fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View confirms a continuous black metal perimeter security fence enclosing the entire truck yard along River Bluff Avenue, with gate sections in the fence line. Driver reviews report a check-in process ('easy and quick check in and out'), confirming a controlled gated entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred TRUE — fully fenced/gated truck yard with a driver check-in process; a guard booth is the HD-RDC norm and the dense SoCal logistics-park standard. Booth not isolated in a clean view (palms/landscaping screen the fence line) — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Continuous loading-dock doors with trailers backed in on all four building faces (N, S, E, W) — inbound and outbound run from separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop area along the north side plus a second parallel trailer row in the south apron; well over 50 trailers visible site-wide.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large site with a deep ring-road / yard approach able to hold a 3+ truck queue inside the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entrance driveway and generous paved yard width leave room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense San Bernardino / Redlands logistics corridor — wall-to-wall distribution buildings, immediately adjacent to I-10. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the east boundary is the I-10 freeway.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box (~700 m x ~330 m developed footprint).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single very large RDC building; neighboring DC buildings are separate properties and excluded.
